reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 5.2(a)(ii) requires MSL to assist in transferring responsibilities and Products to IBM or its designee on expiry/termination (no duration cap, i.e., at least as good as the 6-month/90-day benchmarks), and 5.2(a)(iii) requires return of all IBM documentation and confidential media within a defined post-termination period.

Attachment 6 Section 3(a) adds return of master media plus signed written certification, and Section 13.2(c) gives IBM an on-demand return right, so nothing approaches the walk-away scenario (no data return or immediate deletion of our data).
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was produced; the rendered paragraphs are unchanged.

The shortfalls the rationale identifies (redacted return period, deletion/certification expressed only for the Attachment 6 MS Software Images, no express machine-readable format) are sub-elements short of preferred wording and are correctly noted in the rationale rather than redlined.
The failed deterministic check is a phrasing artifact: the clauses use "transfer"/"return to IBM" rather than "transition"/"export", so the regex miss does not undercut substance.
